_doc: LANCE-19 batch 1 (rev 2): Harasser hovercraft (RGriffin65). No wheels or tracks. ONE launcher turret (the original's single pod): the kit's second rack is dropped, the kept one re-seated on the hull's top centreline.
notes: Vehicle rework (LANCE-19, 2026-10-30), differs from the mech text above: no joints or actuators. HOVER craft: no wheels, no tracks. The fit is level (`no_icp` in harasser_veh.json; the v1 ICP pitched the kit 12 degrees nose-down). The kit has TWO box launcher racks; MC2's Harasser has ONE small launcher pod with two weapon nodes (one turret, full traverse). Revision 2 (Lee, 2026-10-30): one launcher was removed (`drop_parts`: the v1 fit's `weapon_02` rack) and the other (`weapon_01`) re-seated on the hull's top centreline over the kit's round deck ring as the part `turret` (a node under the hull, turns about the vertical axis through the ring centre); the two muzzle nodes weapon_01 / weapon_02 are re-parented under it, one per tube row on the rack's front. The rack keeps the kit's raised pose; no `gun` part. Needle triangles left by the kit's simplification were dropped. Welded at 3 mm and planar-dissolved at 8 degrees, no collapse. (Revision 1 had both racks as `turret_l` / `turret_r`.)
